Messages.Author: Gene Martin
Messages.Body:
Has anyone else noticed that the new promo vampire Lucita is larger than
any of the other vampires? I mean the card is actually a little higher
than all the other cards (the width appears to be the same). Since I
put my crypt in sleeves, this isn't a problem. But if the Sabbat War
cards are the same size as Lucita, this could become a problem with
library cards.

Does anyone know if Lucita was intended to be larger, or if this was
just some sort of misprint problem? Will it be corrected by the time
Sabbar War is printed?

Gene

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Gene Martin wrote:
>
> Has anyone else noticed that the new promo vampire Lucita is larger than
> any of the other vampires? I mean the card is actually a little higher
> than all the other cards (the width appears to be the same).

Yes. And as such, she would be considered a "marked" card in your
crypt unless your crypt was sleeved (or your crypt contained no
vampires other than Lucita).

> Since I
> put my crypt in sleeves, this isn't a problem. But if the Sabbat War
> cards are the same size as Lucita, this could become a problem with
> library cards.
>
> Does anyone know if Lucita was intended to be larger, or if this was
> just some sort of misprint problem? Will it be corrected by the time
> Sabbar War is printed?

It was not intentional. The problem should be fixed for the Sabbat War
cards, as well as for the next promotional card, Vykos.
